concerns.text: Task T001 says “search OpenML for a tabular corrosion dataset that contains the required columns”. The existence of such a dataset is not guaranteed; without a deterministic dataset identifier the task may fail at runtime. Specify a concrete dataset ID or provide a fallback mechanism so the task is always executable.

The verification for T004 requires a “post‑hoc check confirms zero covariance between each interaction column and its constituent main effects”. This description is vague and does not define an automated test. Add an explicit test (e.g., a pytest that computes covariance and asserts it is below a tolerance) to make the verification concrete and reproducible.
